blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: CLIP-like vision-language models remain a cornerstone of multimodal systems, yet their scores stay near chance on directed spatial relations, such as whether one object is left of another. We call this failure readout blindness and analyze, theoretically and empirically, why deployed scores miss the direction: when scoring rules treat the subject and object symmetrically, direction cancels regardless of encoder training. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Antisymmetric Displacement Readout (ADR), which aligns caption words with image patches in the frozen features and scores each relation by the signed displacement between matched object centroids. Notably, ADR succeeds without additional training or learned parameters, thereby demonstrating that directional information remains in the frozen encoder. However, text and world priors can inflate accuracy, so we further introduce prior deflation , which measures the benefit of the image-text pairing as the grounded gain over a null that pairs each item with an unrelated image. Extensive experiments across encoder families show that ADR substantially improves over deployed scores, which remain near chance on most direction-balanced sets even for fine-tuned encoders. Compared with more complex readouts, ADR outperforms the evaluated MLLM likelihood readouts and is competitive with their chat inference at a small fraction of the computation. These results support our claim that directional information can be recovered from frozen features by an appropriate readout. Our implementation and evaluation kit are available at https://github.com/GarryLarry010131/ADR .
blocks.zh: 类似CLIP的视觉语言模型仍然是多模式系统的基石,但其分数在定向空间关系上却几乎没有机会,例如一个物体是否落在另一个物体上。 我们称这种失败读取失明,并在理论和经验上分析为什么部署的分数错失方向:当打分规则对准对象和对象时,不管编码器训练如何,方向都会取消. 在这项分析的指导下,我们引入了“反对称异位读取法”(ADR),它将标题词与被冻结的特性中的图像补丁相接并按匹配对象百分点之间签名的异位对等对等。 值得注意的是,发展成果评估在没有额外培训或学到的参数的情况下取得成功,从而表明方向信息仍然存在于被冻结的编码器中。 然而,文本和世界前传可以提高准确性,因此我们进一步引入了先前的通货紧缩,它衡量图像文本对等的好处,作为对每个项目进行无关联图像对等的无效收益。 对编码器家庭的广泛实验表明,ADR比部署的分数大有改进,在大多数方向平衡的分数组上,即使对编码器进行微调,这些分数仍然几乎有可能。 与更复杂的读出相比,ADR比被评价的MLLM概率读出要好,在计算中的一小部分与他们的聊天推论有竞争力. 这些结果支持我们的说法,即方向信息可以通过适当的读取从被冻结的特性中取出. 我们的执行和评价工具包见https://github.com/GarryLarry010131/ADR。 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Vision-language models such as CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and SigLIP ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) match images and captions through a score computed from separately encoded representations. Their vision encoders are also used in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), which generate answers ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) . This paper concerns the score-based readout. Beyond its efficiency, scores over explicit candidates support ranking and thresholding, making them a natural interface for decision making. This long-standing design ( LeCun et al., 2006 ) is also reflected in recent systems such as Jev ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) . For such decisions to be reliable, the score must capture spatial relations between objects, since the meaning of a caption can depend on whether one object is to the left of, above, or in front of another.
However, existing image-text matching scores remain surprisingly weak at these directional relations, often performing near chance even when the relevant objects are recognized ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2023 ; Kamath et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
CLIP(Radford等,2021年)和SigLIP(Zhai等,2023年)等视觉语言模型通过从单独编码的表示方式计算得分来匹配图像和标题. 他们的视觉编码器也被用于多式大语言模型(MLLMs),生成答案(Liu等,2024;Bai等,2025.). 本文涉及基于分数的读取. 除了其效率外,对明确候选人的分数支持排名和门槛,使它们成为决策的自然界面。 这种由来已久的设计(LeCun等,2006年)也反映在Jev等近代系统中(TypeSafe AI,2026年). 要使这种决定可靠,得分必须记录物体之间的空间关系,因为一个标题的含义可以取决于一个物体是左侧的,上方的,还是前方的.
然而,在这些方向关系上,现有的图像文本匹配得分仍然惊人地微弱,即使相关物体得到承认,也往往表现得接近机会(Yukekgonul等,2023;Kamath等,2023;Liu等,2023)。

blocks.en: Existing works have mainly attributed directional failure to limitations in training or representation, including contrastive objectives ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2023 ) , limited spatial supervision ( Kamath et al., 2023 ) , encoder design, and learning mechanisms ( Alam et al., 2026 ; Yamamoto et al., 2026 ) . Accordingly, most approaches modify the encoder through fine-tuning or additional supervision ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Castro et al., 2024 ; Hoehing et al., 2023 ) . Improvement alone, however, does not explain the original failure: it may come from newly learned spatial cues or from text and world priors. Meanwhile, structural analyses of global embeddings ( Kang et al., 2025 ) and spatial pooling ( Bukkapatnam, 2026 ) explain specific failure mechanisms, but not the broader directional failures observed across deployed scoring rules. Therefore, the question remains unresolved: does the original encoder already contain the directional information that its score fails to expose?
blocks.zh: 现有作品主要将定向失败归因于培训或代表性方面的限制,包括对比性目标(Yukekgonul等,2023年),有限的空间监督(Kamath等,2023年),编码器设计,以及学习机制(Alam等,2026年;山本等,2026年). 因此,大多数方法都通过微调或额外监督修改编码器(Zhang等,2024;Castro等,2024;Hoehing等,2023)。 然而,仅靠改进并不能解释最初的失败:它可能来自新学到的空间提示或文本和世界前传. 同时,对全球嵌入(Kang等人,2025年)和空间集合(Bukkapatnam,2026年)的结构分析解释了具体的失败机制,但并不是在部署的评分规则中观察到的更广泛的方向性失败。 因此,问题仍未解决:原编码器是否已经包含了其分数未能被曝光的方向信息?

blocks.en: To answer this question, we keep the encoder fixed and examine what can be recovered from the features. We find that these features retain directional information, even when the image-text score fails to distinguish direction. We call this gap between what the encoder retains and what the score reveals readout blindness . We support this diagnosis theoretically and empirically, showing that directional failure can arise from the scoring rule even when the information is present in the encoder. This shifts the problem from learning a better representation to designing a better readout.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这个问题,我们保持编码器的固定,并检查从特征中可以回收什么. 我们发现这些特性保留了方向信息,即使图像-文本分数未能区分方向. 我们称编码器所保留的东西和 显示读取失明的东西之间有差距。 我们从理论和经验上支持这种诊断,表明方向性失败可能出自分分规则,即使信息存在于编码器中. 这把问题从学习更好的表述转向设计更好的阅读。

blocks.en: Therefore, we propose the Antisymmetric Displacement Readout (ADR), which recovers relational direction directly from the same frozen encoder. ADR makes the correspondence between caption elements and visual regions explicit and determines direction from the signed displacement between object centroids (Fig. 1 (a)). It requires neither tuning nor additional learned parameters, while its alignment maps and centroids help explain each decision.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提议采用“反对称迁移读取法”,直接从同一种被冻结的编码器中恢复关系方向。 ADR使字幕元素和视觉区域之间的对应关系明确,并确定对象中心机器人之间所签名的移位方向(图1(a))。 它既不需要调试,也不需要额外的已学到的参数,而它的配对图和中间行星有助于解释每个决定.

blocks.en: In addition, we find that priors can drive high performance in readouts without the matched image, making accuracy alone unreliable for evaluating alignment. We therefore introduce prior deflation to assess the contribution of image-caption alignment. We pair each caption with an unrelated image from the same benchmark and score it again. We call this the derangement null and use it to assess prior effects. Prior deflation then subtracts null accuracy from raw accuracy to obtain grounded gain, which measures the benefit of the original image-caption pairing after accounting for prior effects.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们发现前科可以在没有相匹配图像的情况下在读取中驱动高性能,使得准确性单是评价对等性不可靠. 因此,我们采用先行通货紧缩办法,以评估图像封装一致性的贡献。 我们用一个不相关的图像和同一个基准对每个标题进行配对,然后再给它打分。 我们称这为精神错乱无效,并用它来评估先前的影响。 先前的通货紧缩再从原始精度中减去无效精度以获得有根据的收益,在计算先前效果后,该精度衡量原始图像封装成对的好处。

blocks.en: For fairer comparisons, we compare readouts on direction-balanced subsets with near-chance null accuracies. These subsets, prior deflation, reproducible derangement controls and shared scoring rules form our reusable evaluation kit. Under this evaluation, ADR achieves larger grounded gains than deployed readouts, including readouts from fine-tuned encoders. It is also competitive with the chat readouts of MLLMs (Fig. 1 (b)). These results support our diagnosis of readout blindness: directional information can be recovered from frozen encoders by an appropriate readout.
blocks.zh: 为了进行更公平的比较,我们比较关于方向平衡子集的读出和近乎千分之零的读出。 这些子集,先前的通货紧缩,可再生的离散控制以及共享的分数规则,构成了我们的可再用评价包. 根据这一评价,发展成果评估比部署的读出,包括微调编码器的读出,取得了更大的基于结果。 它还与MLLMs的聊天阅读(图1(b))具有竞争力。 这些结果支持我们对读出盲的诊断:方向信息可以通过适当的读出从被冻结的编码器中取回.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: (i) we identify and formalize readout blindness , showing theoretically and empirically that directional failure can arise from the readout; (ii) we propose ADR, a training-free readout that recovers direction through explicit alignment and signed centroid displacement; and (iii) we introduce an evaluation kit combining prior deflation, direction-balanced subsets and shared scoring rules to compare readouts by grounded gain after accounting for prior effects.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献是:(一) 我们确定并正式确定读出失明,从理论上和经验上表明,读出可能会出现方向性故障;(二) 我们提议采用无培训读出法,通过明确校正和签名的百分数迁移来恢复方向;以及(三) 我们采用一个评价包,将以前的通货紧缩、方向平衡子集和共享评分规则结合起来,在计算以前的影响后,根据实实在在的收益来比较读出。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Vision language systems expose several readouts for image text matching. Dual encoders encode the image and text separately and compare the pooled representations with a global similarity ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Zhai et al., 2023 ) . Matching heads in BLIP ( Li et al., 2022 ) , BLIP-2 ( Li et al., 2023 ) and FLAVA ( Singh et al., 2022 ) score image text pairs through cross-modal attention. MLLMs connect a vision encoder to a large language model and offer chat and likelihood readouts ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) , and VQAScore uses the probability of an affirmative answer to a matching question ( Lin et al., 2024 ) . These readouts differ in how the image and text interact, yet none explicitly compares object positions. We therefore treat the readout as the object of study and ask which scoring rules can express relation direction (Sec. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 视觉语言系统曝光了多个图像文本匹配的读取. 双编码器将图像和文本分别编码,并将集合表达与全球相似性进行比较(Radford等,2021;Zhai等,2023.). 在BLIP(Li等,2022年),BLIP-2(Li等,2023年)和FLAVA(Singh等,2022年)中进行对头相配,通过交叉模式关注来分出图像文本对. MLLMs将一个视觉编码器连接到一个大型语言模型,并提供聊天和概率读取(Liu等,2024;Bai等,2025;VQAScore使用对匹配问题的肯定答案的概率(Lin等,2024. 这些读出在图像和文本的相互作用方式上有所不同,但没有人明确比较对象位置. 因此,我们将读取视为研究对象,并询问哪些评分规则可以表达关系方向(第4节)。

blocks.en: Deployed scores remain weak on directional and compositional benchmarks ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2023 ; Kamath et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Thrush et al., 2022 ; Parcalabescu et al., 2022 ) . The remedies in Sec. 1 neither test what frozen features contain nor control for priors. Among structural analyses, Kang et al. (2025) show that an idealized CLIP embedding cannot represent spatial relations and train DCSM on similarity maps. Bukkapatnam (2026) attribute the failure to permutation-invariant pooling, but their accuracy bound assumes equal caption scores for one image, which their proof does not establish. Neither uses a prior control. We instead derive when a scoring rule cannot separate directions (Sec. 4 ) and measure grounded gain (Sec. 6 ).
blocks.zh: 部署的分数在方向和构成基准方面仍然薄弱(Yuksekgonul等,2023;Kamath等,2023;Liu等,2023;Thrush等,2022;Parcalabescu等,2022)。 第1节中的补救办法既不检验所冻结的特征包含的内容,也不检验对前科的控制。 在结构分析中,Kang等人(2025年)表明,理想化的CLIP嵌入不能代表空间关系,在相似性地图上训练DCSM. Bukkapatnam (2026) 将失败归结为 permution-invariant 集合,但他们的精度约束假设一个图像具有等同的字幕分数,而他们的证明并没有证实这一点. 既不使用前置控制。 相反,当一个评分规则不能区分方向(第4款)和衡量有根据的收益(第6款)时,我们就会得出结果。

blocks.en: An explicit alignment is a correspondence between text tokens and image regions that a method computes and exposes. Optimal transport (OT) couplings play this role by matching patches or concepts across modalities ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) and by supporting interpretation in language tasks ( Jia et al., 2026 ) . ReCLIP resolves spatial relations by comparing the centers of detector proposals ( Subramanian et al., 2022 ) . These couplings carry individual concepts rather than directed relations and are read through trained modules. ReCLIP is training-free, but it takes direction from hand-coded box rules over external proposals rather than from the alignment itself. ADR builds on the same OT coupling (Sec. 3 ) and reads direction from the frozen encoder’s own alignment through an antisymmetric kernel (Sec. 5 ).

blocks.en: 4 Readout Blindness
blocks.zh: 4 读取失明

blocks.en: For an image I I , a directional score F ⁡ ( I , C ) F(I,C) must rank the correct caption C + C^{+} above a distractor C − C^{-} with the subject and object swapped (an argument swap). These captions contain the same words but express different relations. We analyze the scoring rules behind these failures and prove that inappropriate readouts can cause direction blindness, which encoder training alone cannot resolve.

blocks.en: The theorems identify a structural form of readout blindness, where the scoring rule prevents directional discrimination regardless of feature values. Thus, encoder training alone cannot break these ties. The experiments also reveal directional failures in readouts beyond these theorems. Together, these findings motivate a readout that preserves relation direction through an antisymmetric image kernel and uses explicit alignment to compare object positions.

blocks.en: ADR in Sec. 5 recovers direction without fine-tuning or additional learned parameters. We next assess how much of the performance comes from image-text alignment, because a readout can use text and world priors to favor the correct answer even without the paired image. High accuracy alone therefore does not show that a readout correctly aligns the image and caption. We introduce an evaluation kit that combines prior deflation, direction-balanced evaluation sets and shared scoring rules. Prior deflation uses a derangement null to assess prior effects and reports grounded gain as a measure of image-text alignment after accounting for these effects (Fig. 3 ).

Prior deflation therefore reports the grounded gain as gain = Acc real − Acc null \mathrm{gain}=\mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{real}}-\mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{null}} , where the two accuracies use the original pairing and the derangement null, respectively. A positive gain indicates a benefit from the paired image. Each readout is compared with its own null because readouts exploit prior preferences to different degrees. blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We identify readout blindness as a source of directional failure in VLMs and show why some scoring rules cannot distinguish direction. This analysis leads to ADR, which reads direction from an explicit alignment of frozen features without training or learned parameters. We also introduce an evaluation kit that separates grounded gain from prior effects. ADR improves grounded gain over deployed scores on most tested sets, showing that the frozen features retain direction that an appropriate readout can recover. Future work includes broader multimodal alignment tasks, more complex relations beyond noun pairs, and extensions to a wider range of VLM architectures.
blocks.zh: 我们确定读出盲是VLMs中方向性故障的一个源头,并表明为什么某些分数规则无法区分方向. 这一分析导致ADR,它读取方向是明确调整被冻结的特征,而不经过培训或学习到的参数。 我们还采用了一套评价工具,将以往效果的有根据收益区分开来。 ADR比大多数测试集的部署分数提高了定点收益,显示被冻结的特性保留了适当的读出可以恢复的方向. 今后的工作包括更广泛的多模式对接任务,超出名词对接的更复杂关系,并扩展至更广泛的VLM架构.

blocks.en: For front/behind relations, ADR uses the image vertical axis: in front of is + y +y (lower in the image), and behind is − y -y (higher in the image). This axis was chosen after exploratory VG-Relation analysis and fixed before evaluation on disjoint VG-Relation images and What’sUp-B. It uses image position as a depth cue rather than estimating three-dimensional depth. The positive-displacement interpretation in Sec. 5 therefore applies to this proxy for front/behind: correct object localization alone does not guarantee the correct three-dimensional relation. The absence of training refers to encoder weights and learned readout parameters; this axis was selected manually from the exploratory analysis.

blocks.en: The MLLM readouts are run plainly, with no system prompt, no worked example, no chain of thought, no retry and no self-consistency, greedy decoding with a four-token budget, and the optional thinking mode of the one model that has it turned off. blocks.zh: E.5 关于五种平衡组合的半作物干预

blocks.en: The image is cut into its left, right, top and bottom halves, each half is encoded once, and a caption is scored by comparing its subject and object words with the two halves on either side of its relation axis. On VG-Relation left/right the margin is the true caption’s score minus the false caption’s. On COCO-spatial and What’sUp-A every candidate is scored along its own axis and the highest score wins with ties split, on the 404 404 and 408 408 items where every caption parses. What’sUp-B uses the same 354 354 items as ADR. Left/right relations use horizontal image halves, while front/behind relations follow the depth rule, with in front of as lower in the image and behind as higher (App. D.5 ). On VSR the margin is the statement’s score minus its score with subject and object exchanged, read by its sign on the covered 1201 1201 items. Every set is scored against its own derangement null (App. E.6 ).
